# Ahmed Ansari (alwaysahmedansari)
> Official identity and link directory of Ahmed Ansari: author, independent researcher and editorial writer based in Lahore, Pakistan, and founder of InkVerse Global.

## Identity
- Full name: Ahmed Ansari

- Roles: Author, Independent Researcher, Editorial Writer; Founder and lead of InkVerse Global
- Languages: English and Urdu
- Areas: Human psychology, history and civilisation, politics and society, religion, philosophy, education and youth, Urdu literature

## InkVerse Global
- Independent editorial, research and digital publishing practice, Lahore, Pakistan, led by Ahmed Ansari.
